method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: Datalab API key for PDF to Markdown conversion

evidence.quote: In Zotero Settings there is a Datalab Settings pane that will allow you to set your API key.
This is an plugin for Zotero 7 that converts PDFs to Markdown using Datalab.to

checkNote: README says "a Datalab Settings pane that will allow you to set your API key", and the default apikey pref is empty. Conversion goes through the cloud service Datalab.to, so the plugin cannot do its job without a key. No local-model support appears anywhere in the pack.
